snippet.title: Arms of God - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam:  
⚔️https://store.steampowered.com/app/3100310/Arms_of_God/⚔️

ARMS OF GOD is a next-gen autoshooter with Doom-inspired gore vibes, metal music, roguelite mechanics, and a satisfying combat feel. Wield five weapons at once, upgrade and merge them to forge indestructible builds, and bring divine justice to a world on the brink of chaos.

FEATURES of Arms of God:
⚔️Hand-sculpted, hand-painted, and animated 3D characters (no AI)
⚔️Fully immersive 3D environments powered by Unreal Engine 5
⚔️A one-of-a-kind fantasy narrative, revealing new, mysterious layers of the story as players progress
⚔️An expansive metaprogression system intertwined with story progression and achievements
⚔️Surprising build crafting options—mix and match weapons with upgrades to discover new synergies
⚔️A deeply satisfying gore system
⚔️Each hero comes with an active ability and a unique skill tree
⚔️Auto-firing from up to 5 weapons simultaneously, with optional manual aiming
⚔️ Created by a solo developer
